expectations.text: Draws out specifics from the vague input (asks questions OR makes explicit assumptions)
expectations.evidence: Asked 6 clarifying questions covering what, who, how, trigger, privacy, and scope. Then made 5 explicit assumptions when moving to draft. More questions than the with_skill version (6 vs 3), but still drew out specifics.

expectations.text: Produces a Job Story in 'When [situation], I want to [action], so I can [outcome]' format with specific details
expectations.evidence: Job Story: 'When I'm looking at a trading opportunity or portfolio view in Replay and want a colleague's input, I want to generate a shareable link I can send them, so I can get feedback without having to screenshot or describe what I'm seeing.'

expectations.text: Produces a Promise that is testable and concrete, not vague
expectations.evidence: Promise: 'any authenticated user in the same organization can open a shared link and see the exact same view (data + layout) that the sharer was looking at when they created the link.' Testable and specific.

expectations.text: Produces Acceptance Criteria that are independently verifiable with checkbox format
expectations.evidence: 6 acceptance criteria in checkbox format, each independently verifiable: generate shareable link, copy to clipboard, teammate sees same view, unauthenticated error, no arbitrary expiration, discoverable share action.

expectations.text: Includes Constraints section identifying what should not change
expectations.evidence: 4 constraints: authenticated users only (same org), read-only, no data duplication/forking, existing navigation/URLs must not break.

expectations.text: Presents the complete draft for user confirmation before creating
expectations.evidence: Confirmation Step explicitly asks: 'Here's the draft issue. Before I create it, please review' with 3 specific questions about Job Story accuracy, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.

expectations.text: Shows the acorn issue create command that would be run
expectations.evidence: Shows full command: acorn issue create replay "Add shareable links for trading views" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'...EOF)" with complete issue body. Note: does not include --label ready-for-spec flag.
